candidates.name: WCS coverage description and RangeType
verified_facts: Coverage descriptions include mandatory rangeType metadata describing coverage range structure.

candidates.name: WCS exploitation metadata
verified_facts: DescribeCoverage exploitation metadata can describe bands with names units data type and nil values.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 1m
verified_facts: The primary product is a raster terrain elevation model at nominal 1m resolution and values are presented in metres.

candidates.name: EA WCS support guidance
verified_facts: EA exposes raster elevation data through WCS GeoTIFF responses.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 1m vertical reference
verified_facts: The DTM is presented in metres and referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn.

candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: EA LIDAR DTM delivery is in metres and referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn with OS Grid alignment.

candidates.name: Coverage range metadata model
verified_facts: Coverage rangeType is part of the authoritative coverage description rather than inferred from horizontal CRS.

candidates.name: EA WCS service
verified_facts: The pinned DTM1m WCS endpoint is the current official Environment Agency service used by the slot contract.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Grid data technical specification
verified_facts: Terrain50 ASCII is supplied alongside GML and the GML provides metadata including location grid spacing and vertical reference system.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 source data
verified_facts: Z values are heights in metres relative to the datum for the area and most areas use Ordnance Datum Newlyn.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 product supply
verified_facts: Terrain50 grid supply is ASCII grid plus GML 3.2.1 in 10km tiles.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 documentation
verified_facts: Terrain50 is an official OpenData height product updated annually in July.

candidates.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons
verified_facts: Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID and the dataset is published as GML.

candidates.name: National Polygon technical specification
verified_facts: HMLR states INSPIRE polygons have simpler attributes including identifier create date and polygon last-updated date.

candidates.name: INSPIRE GML technical guidance
verified_facts: HMLR source geometry is captured against British National Grid.

candidates.name: Current INSPIRE download release
verified_facts: The current download release was published 5 July 2026 and is replaced monthly.

candidates.name: RFC 9530 Digest Fields
verified_facts: Content-Digest supports integrity validation of actual HTTP message content.

candidates.name: RFC 9530 representation digest
verified_facts: Repr-Digest supports integrity validation of selected HTTP representation data.

candidates.name: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics
verified_facts: HTTP representations are the transferable data and metadata reflecting resource state.

candidates.name: RFC 9110 validator fields
verified_facts: Strong validators can identify exact representation versions and collision-resistant representation hashes are sufficient validators.

candidates.name: RFC 9110 selected representation semantics
verified_facts: A selected representation is intended to reflect a resource state at the time it is generated.

candidates.name: RFC 9110 current validator semantics
verified_facts: Validator fields describe the current selected representation and can distinguish resource versions over time.

candidates.name: RFC 9530 representation integrity
verified_facts: Representation integrity requires digesting the representation being validated rather than trusting stale metadata alone.

candidates.name: Current monthly INSPIRE release
verified_facts: Current authoritative source releases change over time, reinforcing the need to bind web acceptance to the current canonical expectation.

candidates.name: RFC 9110 strong validators
verified_facts: Collision-resistant hashes applied to representation data can serve as strong version validators.

candidates.name: RFC 9530 integrity digests
verified_facts: Hash digests can be used by receivers to validate content or representation integrity.

candidates.name: WCS coverage description model
verified_facts: Coverage domain and range metadata belong to one described coverage representation and should remain bound through sampling.

candidates.name: Current INSPIRE authority GML release
verified_facts: HMLR authority GML files are current-version source artifacts replaced by later monthly releases.
